passage: Q: Is clear, odorless air always safe to breathe? A: No. Many dangerous pollutants, such as carbon monoxide, are invisible and odorless. Q: Does boiling water make it safe to drink? A: Boiling kills germs, but it cannot remove dissolved chemical pollutants like pesticides or lead. For that, we need advanced filtration. Q: Is the greenhouse effect always bad for Earth? A: No, it is a natural process that keeps our planet warm enough to support life. However, human activities have increased greenhouse gases, leading to harmful global warming. Q: Does the ozone hole cause global warming? A: No, the ozone layer protects us from harmful ultraviolet rays, while global warming is caused by the trapping of heat by greenhouse gases. Q: Is smog just natural fog? A: No, smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, often containing harmful particles from vehicle exhaust and industrial emissions. Q: Does the holy nature of a river protect it from pollution? A: No, even rivers considered sacred can be heavily polluted by industrial waste and sewage. Pollution is a physical reality, not a spiritual one. Q: Is acid rain as strong as battery acid? A: No, while acid rain can damage buildings and plants, it is much weaker than the concentrated acid found in car batteries.

items.evidence: Boiling kills germs, but it cannot remove dissolved chemical pollutants like pesticides or lead.
items.q: A village well has pesticide in it. Will boiling the water make it safe?
options: No, boiling leaves dissolved chemicals in it
Yes, heat breaks chemicals down into gases
Yes, if it is boiled for a long time
No, boiling cannot even kill the germs
items.explain: Boiling kills germs but cannot remove dissolved chemicals like pesticides or lead.

wrong.why: reverses what boiling does to germs

items.evidence: Many dangerous pollutants, such as carbon monoxide, are invisible and odorless.
items.q: A room's air looks clear and smells fresh. Why can it still be harmful?
options: Some harmful gases cannot be seen or smelled
Clear air always holds a thick hidden fog
Fresh smell hides only the germs in air
Harmful gases always make a strong smell
items.explain: Pollutants like carbon monoxide are invisible and odorless, so clear fresh-smelling air can still be polluted.

wrong.why: links polluted air to thick fog
thinks pollution always has a smell

items.evidence: No, it is a natural process that keeps our planet warm enough to support life.
items.q: If the natural greenhouse effect did not exist, what would happen to Earth?
options: It would be too cold for life
It would be safe from global warming only
It would be hit by more ultraviolet rays
It would be covered by a glass shell
items.explain: The natural greenhouse effect keeps Earth warm enough for life, so without it Earth would be too cold.

wrong.why: thinks the greenhouse effect is only harmful
mixes up the ozone layer with greenhouse effect
thinks greenhouse gases form a solid shell

items.evidence: No, even rivers considered sacred can be heavily polluted by industrial waste and sewage.
items.q: A sacred river has dirty water and foam. Which reason best explains this?
options: Factories and sewage can pollute any river
Only rivers that are not holy get polluted
Holy rivers clean themselves of all waste
Its dirt comes from the ozone hole
items.explain: Even sacred rivers can be heavily polluted by industrial waste and sewage; pollution is physical, not spiritual.

wrong.why: thinks holy rivers cannot be polluted
links the ozone hole to unrelated problems

items.evidence: No, while acid rain can damage buildings and plants, it is much weaker than the concentrated acid found in car batteries.
items.q: How does acid rain compare with the acid in a car battery?
options: It is much weaker but still harmful
It is equally strong and just as harmful
It is stronger but falls over wide areas
It is weaker and so causes no damage
items.explain: Acid rain damages buildings and plants but is much weaker than concentrated battery acid.

wrong.why: thinks acid rain is as strong as battery acid
thinks weak acid cannot damage anything
